evals.title: Intake when concern is missing
evals.prompt:
[Workspace state — read but do not narrate back:
- Caller did not supply a concern or mode survey.
- JOURNAL names no specific question.]

Research this for me.
evals.expected_output: Behavioural response satisfying: - AskUserQuestion survey first vs I will name a concern (neither recommended). It must NOT: - Start a depth web search with an empty concern. - Offer EDA Open questions as a closed concern menu as if they were literature. - Drop a column or rewrite raw data.
expectations: AskUserQuestion survey first vs I will name a concern (neither recommended).
The response does NOT: Start a depth web search with an empty concern.
The response does NOT: Offer EDA Open questions as a closed concern menu as if they were literature.
The response does NOT: Drop a column or rewrite raw data.

evals.title: Skip intake when concern is supplied
evals.prompt:
[Workspace state — read but do not narrate back:
- Concern and domain are in the prompt.]

Research whether a 0.97 Pearson with the target is leakage on
this regression table. Domain is real estate.
evals.expected_output: Behavioural response satisfying: - Run distinct-angle **depth** searches (practice, implementation, pitfalls at least). - Tag each candidate with a lane (`measure` / `declare` / `evaluate` / `confirm`). - Write `scratch/research/<slug>.md`. It must NOT: - Re-ask domain and concern. - Run a survey first. - Drop the correlated column.
expectations: Run distinct-angle **depth** searches (practice, implementation, pitfalls at least).
Tag each candidate with a lane (`measure` / `declare` / `evaluate` / `confirm`).
Write `scratch/research/<slug>.md`.
Return the path and a one- or two-sentence finding to the caller.
The response does NOT: Re-ask domain and concern.
The response does NOT: Run a survey first.
The response does NOT: Drop the correlated column.
The response does NOT: Run `pixi add` / `uv add`.
The response does NOT: Write `data_analysis.md` or the design note.
The response does NOT: Paste the full scratch note into chat.
